name: BMW K1 / K1100RS / K1100LT
engine: 987 or 1092 cc liquid-cooled flat inline four, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: BMW's flying-brick fours of the 90s. Bosch fuel injection, Paralever on the K1 and a lot of bodywork.

K: Check and grease the clutch and transmission input splines. Dry splines are a known cause of wear on these.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
